summary: OpenAI released version 0.21.1 of its openai-agents-python SDK, adding sandbox and timeout features and fixing several bugs in session handling, realtime audio, and sandbox path normalization.

practices.reason: Teams using the agents SDK should note new sandbox configuration options and timeout controls, and the various bug fixes to sessions and realtime handling, when upgrading.
practices.quote: feat(sandbox): allow Docker sandboxes to disable networking by @koadegno
